psql positive-fetch.reason: psql 17 FETCH_COUNT uses PQsetChunkedRowsMode after PQsendQuery/PQsendQueryParams; this is client-side libpq chunk delivery, not Execute.max_rows. Older psql FETCH_COUNT used SQL DECLARE/FETCH, excluded by ADR 0015. No psql wire portal-size option.

psycopg positive-fetch.reason: psycopg 3.3.8 Cursor.fetchmany slices a client-side PGresult; stream uses libpq row delivery, not Execute.max_rows. ServerCursor emits SQL DECLARE/FETCH (explicit 0A000 boundary); pq.PGconn send_query_params/send_query_prepared expose no max_rows.

pgcli positive-fetch.reason: pgcli 4.7.1 PGExecute uses psycopg ProtocolSafeCursor and libpq; completion/output paging does not set Execute.max_rows. No public portal-fetch size API; SQL DECLARE/FETCH remains outside ADR 0015.

ADBC positive-fetch.reason: ADBC PostgreSQL 1.13.0 default SELECT uses COPY TO STDOUT; Arrow batch size controls Arrow delivery, not Execute.max_rows. use_copy=false uses libpq query results and exposes no wire portal max_rows option.

psql malformed-frame.reason: psql SQL/meta-command API accepts SQL and COPY data; libpq encodes framing. No API for an invalid message tag/length. Invalid SQL or COPY payload is not a malformed frontend frame; proxy/raw socket corruption is separate evidence.

pgjdbc malformed-frame.reason: pgjdbc 42.7.14 JDBC/PGConnection public APIs encode protocol frames internally. No public API sets message tag/declared length; using internal PGStream or an injecting socket factory replaces the transport and is separate fault-injection evidence.

psycopg malformed-frame.reason: psycopg 3.3.8 Cursor and pq.PGconn query/COPY APIs delegate frame encoding to libpq. PGconn.socket exposes a descriptor, but writing fabricated bytes to it is raw protocol injection, not a psycopg emission API.

pgcli malformed-frame.reason: pgcli 4.7.1 PGExecute uses psycopg/libpq encoders; its SQL, special-command and completion APIs cannot specify frontend frame lengths/tags. Writing to the underlying psycopg socket would be a separate raw injection probe.

ADBC malformed-frame.reason: ADBC PostgreSQL 1.13.0 database/connection/statement and Arrow stream APIs do not expose frontend frame bytes, lengths or a connection socket. Malformed SQL/COPY contents do not exercise malformed frame headers; a proxy/raw probe is separate evidence.
